d:
The Suns defeated the Magic, 117-104, tonight in Phoenix. Devin Booker contributed a team-high 30 points to go with 8 assists, 4 three-pointers, and 3 steals, with Dillon Brooks of the Suns adding an additional 24 points (9-16 FG, 4-6 3PT). Wendell Carter Jr. finished with a team-high 27 points along with 13 rebounds for the Magic in the losing effort. The Suns improve their record to 2-5 with the win, while the Magic fall to 2-6 for the season.
